name: Facet
text: Make the legend a sticky panel anchored to the left edge of the graph. It stays visible at all times, so users never hunt for it—clarity wins. The trade-off: it shrinks the graph’s width slightly, but visibility and speed of understanding outweigh that loss.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A sticky legend still risks crowding the graph when users zoom into dense data—users lose context faster than they gain it. Better: a floating, collapsible icon that expands on hover, preserving space while making the legend discoverable. Settle it with a usability test: track how often users access the legend in both designs at different zoom levels.
